# CRuby's exception hierarchy, measured. Do not edit by hand.
#
# Generated by `scripts/exceptions-oracle.rb --generate`; CI re-runs it with
# `--check`. One `Name < Superclass` per line, parents before children, which
# is the order `Classes::bootstrap` defines them in.
#
# `Exception < Object` is the root and is bootstrapped as a `Builtin` before
# this table is read; it is listed anyway so the file is the whole truth
# rather than the truth minus one line.

Exception                 < Object
NoMemoryError             < Exception
ScriptError               < Exception
SecurityError             < Exception
SignalException           < Exception               # own initialize
StandardError             < Exception
SystemExit                < Exception               # own initialize
SystemStackError          < Exception
ArgumentError             < StandardError
EncodingError             < StandardError
FiberError                < StandardError
IOError                   < StandardError
IndexError                < StandardError
Interrupt                 < SignalException         # own initialize
LoadError                 < ScriptError
LocalJumpError            < StandardError
NameError                 < StandardError           # own initialize
NoMatchingPatternError    < StandardError
NotImplementedError       < ScriptError
RangeError                < StandardError
RegexpError               < StandardError
RuntimeError              < StandardError
SyntaxError               < ScriptError             # own initialize
SystemCallError           < StandardError           # own initialize
ThreadError               < StandardError
TypeError                 < StandardError
ZeroDivisionError         < StandardError
EOFError                  < IOError
FloatDomainError          < RangeError
FrozenError               < RuntimeError            # own initialize
KeyError                  < IndexError              # own initialize
NoMatchingPatternKeyError < NoMatchingPatternError  # own initialize
NoMethodError             < NameError               # own initialize
StopIteration             < IndexError
UncaughtThrowError        < ArgumentError           # own initialize
ClosedQueueError          < StopIteration
